setup-inject-negative.expression: (async()=>{const sm=stateHooks.getPerpsStreamManager(); const p=await stateHooks.submitRequestToBackground('perpsGetPositions',[]); const next=(p&&p.length?p:[{symbol:'BTC',size:'0.001',entryPrice:'80000',positionValue:'80',unrealizedPnl:'0',marginUsed:'10',leverage:{type:'cross',value:40},liquidationPrice:'-1',maxLeverage:40,returnOnEquity:'0',cumulativeFunding:{allTime:'0',sinceOpen:'0',sinceChange:'0'},takeProfitCount:0,stopLossCount:0}]).map((pos,i)=>i===0?{...pos,liquidationPrice:'-1',leverage:{...(pos.leverage||{}),type:'cross'}}:pos); sm.positions.pushData(next); return JSON.stringify({count:next.length, first:next[0]});})()
